prompt: A sturdy storm-wizard in rain-soaked cerulean and sapphire robes stands in a rigid side profile facing south-west on a wind-lashed clifftop, leaning into a gale, one arm raised toward the sky. A glowing parchment page, edges crackling with pale blue lightning, is being drawn out of the swirling storm clouds down into his outstretched hand. Behind him, a half-formed summoned ally of luminous blue energy takes shape from the same storm. The only source of light is the cold electric-blue glow of the page and the lightning. The background is a churning grey-black thunderhead sky over a dark sea.

A storm-wizard in soot-grey and cerulean robes stands three-quarter view in a stone observatory tower open to the sky, both hands cupped upward as a glowing arcane scroll materializes from a small indoor whirlwind of crackling blue lightning and settles toward his fingers. Beside him a translucent summoned sapphire familiar coalesces out of the swirling air. The only source of light is the cold electric-blue glow of the scroll and the lightning arcs. The background is the tower interior with arched stone windows showing a thunderstorm raging outside.
